defects.detail: Bottom-right box reads 'Ref. Dwg. TJC-LLD-PID-XXXX'; datasheet, GA drawing and C&E cross-reference TJC-LLD-PID-8901.
Note 2 'Refer to Datasheet TJC-LLD-GA-FA-8901' cites the GA drawing number; FA-8901's datasheet is TJC-LLD-DS-FA-8901.
GA-1201A tags on a static drum: XV-1201A/B (both risers), PSLL 1201, PI 1201, TSHH-1201; Set 1 line numbers 4"-HC-1002-CS02-I and 8"-HC-1002-CS02-I; the 30 kW motor.

'PSV-8901 Suction Pressure LOW-LOW Setpoint: 0.5 barg' on a pressure-switch symbol (datasheet PSV-8901 set 10 barg, the drum label itself reads 'PSV set. 10 barg'; 0.5 barg is GA-1201A's PSLL-1201 trip); 'HS-5901' for C&E T4 HS-8901; 'PT-8202' for permissive PT-8902; 'ZSO-4901 Suction OPEN' (SEQ-8901 has no valve-position permissive); 'FI 8012' under the FI-8912 line label; TT-8911 and PT-8913 tags on valve symbols; PCV-8905 (vent, EFF-3) drawn on the boot drain line; 'HV-8904' printed twice.

Set 1's pump-suction train (FROM TANK, XV, 'Suction OPEN' permissive, PT/PI, pressure switch, 4" reducer, MINIMUM FLOW BYPASS 'OPEN on Low Flow', XV-1201A/B with ZS, NRV) and motor 'M 30kW ... Foundation as per GA drawing' are reproduced on a static drum (datasheet DRIVER TYPE None (static)).
'(Searing Temp Temp)', 'Auto-drain vaint', 'Passing/ Loaking fix', '(per CSE)', 'y2' nozzle label, 'PSV set.'.

No title block: the vessel label 'REFLUX ACCUMULATOR DRUM' and the Ref. Dwg. box only; 'from COLUMN DA-8910' is drawn as an arrow leaving the sheet; the C&E start permissives (LT-8901, PT-8902, LT-8903, DCS reset) appear only as the caption 'START PERMISSIVE (AND-gate)'.
